purpose: Unapproved isolated hero concepts; no production integration

variants.name: Наследник
variants.design: Mature short dark brown hair and short trimmed brown beard, open visible face. Simple navy blue long robe split around the boots, a single muted forest-green central tabard, short brass collar and simple belt buckle. Small plain shoulders, modest bracers, plain dark leather boots. A simplified familiar adventurer silhouette, not an ornate legendary hero.
variants.prompt: One full-body male mage player character for a top-down dark fantasy pixel-art survivors game. South/front facing, subtle low top-down view, neutral idle, both feet planted and both empty hands visible. Medium-detail hand-pixelled game sprite, broad readable silhouette, deliberate chunky pixel clusters, dark selective outlines, three clearly separated shade steps per material, restrained small highlights, subdued cloth and leather. Grounded human proportions with a slightly enlarged readable head, NOT chibi.
